body: Kleos is a B2B Influencer Marketing Agency using B2B creators your buyers already trust.

Kleos is a B2B influencer marketing agency built by LinkedIn Alumni who understand exactly how B2B buyers make decisions. We connect brands with the trusted creators their buyers already follow and use LinkedIn Thought Leader Ads to put your message in front of the right buying committee, at the right moment, before your competitors get there.
Everything we do is engineered around one outcome: pipeline. Our team brings experience managing over $75M in ad spend and generating $700M in pipeline.

items.question: What is a B2B Influencer Marketing Agency?
items.answer: A B2B influencer marketing agency connects brands with trusted industry voices to reach their buying committee. Unlike B2C influencer marketing, B2B focuses on credibility, thought leadership and pipeline generation rather than followers and likes.

items.question: What are Thought Leader Ads?
items.answer: Thought Leader Ads are a LinkedIn ad format that lets brands run paid promotions through the personal profiles of trusted industry creators. They appear more authentic than traditional ads because they come from real people your buyers already follow and trust.

items.question: How does Kleos generate pipeline?
items.answer: We start by identifying the B2B creators your buying committee already trusts. We build campaigns around their authority and amplify that content through LinkedIn Thought Leader Ads to get your brand in front of the right decision makers.

items.question: How is this different from traditional LinkedIn advertising?
items.answer: Traditional LinkedIn ads come from brand pages buyers scroll past. Thought Leader Ads come from real people buyers already follow meaning higher engagement, warmer leads and faster sales cycles.

items.question: Do you work with in-person events too?
items.answer: Yes. We bridge online and offline influence helping brands show up in LinkedIn feeds and on conference stages so buyers encounter your brand in every room that matters.

items.question: Who is Kleos best suited for?
items.answer: Kleos works best with B2B SaaS companies, tech brands and professional services firms who want to reach their buying committee before their sales team does.
